links.outcome: DART sensitivity and specificity corrected using the appropriate reference standard and conditional probability
links.effect: Corrected sensitivity and specificity were significantly lower than originally reported in all three scenarios (retinography sensitivity 90%, 80%, 70%). Retinography by an ophthalmologist outperformed DART on FN%, FP%, NPV and PPV.
links.quote: In all scenarios, corrected sensitivity and specificity values for DART were significantly lower than those reported in the original validation study.

screen.reason: Empirical re-evaluation of an AI screening tool's real-world diagnostic accuracy by assessing the impact of choosing an appropriate gold standard vs flawed reference standard.

primary.practice: reference standard correction and conditional probability validation
